name: Home lab with SAN and bespoke home network

mentions.name: Home lab with SAN and bespoke home network
mentions.description: This home lab project assembles a SAN and compute nodes from old spare parts and second-hand servers in a custom-built rack, paired with a bespoke home network replacing ISP-provided equipment. It was motivated by needs and preferences outgrowing commodity systems and default setups.
mentions.problem: Long-standing aversion to configuration and customization, with needs and preferences that outgrew commodity systems and default setups.
mentions.source_excerpt: Personal project - long past due to set up a home lab so I'm piecing together a SAN and some compute from old parts i have laying around and some second hand servers in a new rack I put together, along with setting up a bespoke home network instead of just using ISP stuff.
